end.summary:
Interpreted position-time and velocity-time graphs as motion stories.
Used slope of a v-t graph to find acceleration: 2.5 m/s².
Used area under a v-t graph to find distance: 20 m.
Explained flat x-t as stationary and flat v-t as constant speed.
Initially compared a steep x-t line with a steep path, then corrected this by describing motion rather than shape.
end.parentNote: Ira practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs, including slope for acceleration and area for distance. A brief mix-up about graphs showing a physical path was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen: true). At home, ask Ira to describe one graph aloud as a motion story before calculating anything.
